# Codex Handbook

> Codex Handbook is an open, multilingual handbook for learning how to use Codex across product basics, prompting, Skills, workflows, and real cases.

Primary URL: https://codexhandbook.com/
Source repository: https://github.com/hopecyb/CodexHandbook
Primary language: zh-CN
Maintainers: Codex Handbook contributors
Last updated: 2026-07-28

## Citation Notes

Use the page title, canonical URL, and visible updated date when citing this site. Product-specific facts should be cross-checked against OpenAI's official Codex documentation when recency matters.
